fair_value_reason: I recomputed each agent's own methods on the corrected peer basis: horizon P/E 4.9x (4.5x NTM median + ~9% US-listing premium), NTM EV/EBITDA 3.5x, and A4's normalized multiple 9.0x. A1 $990 to ~$939; A2 $1,021 to ~$973; A3 $925 to ~$916; A4 $1,103 to ~$1,056; A5 $980 to ~$968. Mean ~$970 (from $1,004), about 10% below spot. Cross-check: $200 x 4.9x = $980; cycle-aware DCFs give $790-1,060.

thesis_triggers.event: $615 (the agents' mean, -43%) is ~4.5x (the corrected peer median) on FY28 EPS of ~$100-105 plus ~$175/sh of horizon net cash, or ~2.2x FY28 consensus excluding cash. That means pricing a halving of FY28 earnings: contract prices rolling over before the 2028 cleanroom additions, or SCA floors being renegotiated. Primary guidance (supply constrained through CY28, take-or-pay floors at above-prior-peak margins) contradicts both, so trading there would signal a real cycle turn rather than noise.

supervisor_summary: Every company figure checks out against the 8-K and prepared remarks, and the SCAs are explicitly take-or-pay ($150B RPO at minimum prices, $12.7B deposits). Samsung and SK hynix have struck the same kind of deals, though, and the floor protects only ~7% of peak EPS. That softens memory's trough but does not justify a multiple above the peer median. All five agents built on a peer median of 4.7x that double-adjusted vendor figures already on an NTM basis. The consistent NTM median is ~4.5x P/E and ~3.5x EV/EBITDA, so corrected fair value is ~$970 (~10% below spot) with a median near $1,040. The ladder sits ~0.02 below the agent mean above $967. The open question is still when in 2027 the market starts pricing the 2028 supply wave.
key_drivers: FQ1 FY27 guide: $61.5B revenue and $38.15 non-GAAP EPS, ~8% above consensus. FQ1 is the stated FY27 gross-margin floor, with revenue rising every quarter (8-K EX-99.1; prepared remarks).

Valuation regime on a corrected NTM basis: core memory peers at ~4.5x P/E and ~3.5x EV/EBITDA, against MU at 6.1x and ~4.4x. At the horizon the market prices FY28 (~$200 EPS) near a perceived peak, so ~4.9x gives ~$980 before cash credit.

Take-or-pay SCAs: 26 deals, >35% of revenue through 2030, ~$150B RPO at minimum prices, $32B commitments, $12.7B deposits. They are real (primary text) but sector-wide (Samsung 60-70% LTA coverage, SK hynix ~10 customers), and the floor covers only ~$14/sh a year of earnings against ~$200 of peak EPS.
Supply-wave timing: Micron ID1 and Tongluo mid-2027, SK hynix Y1 Feb-2027, Samsung P5 1H27, then Japan, ID2 and Singapore NAND from late 2028. FY27 capex is >$50B and construction-heavy.
Cash build: $55.6B net cash excluding deposits grows to ~$200B (~$175/sh) by Oct 2027, with capital return stepping up from 9 Dec 2026.
